note: BH-6374. 1: mc_resolve_conflicts merges an add/add path with the squash commit as its base (git merge-file <branch> <squash:path> <main>) when a stacked child's base PR merged as a squash and the branch carries that exact blob. A clean result is staged with a Union-resolved trailer, so the approval is re-reviewed, never rebound. 0: the path stays a real conflict, as before. The conductor rebase and the pool rebase job both read it.
